info.title: API.SH: Weedmaps
info.description: The Weedmaps API from API.SH: public Weedmaps data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Weedmaps dispensary, delivery or doctor profile
get.description:
One Weedmaps listing (dispensary, delivery service, doctor, store or venue) by link or slug: name, type, rating and review count, license type, full address and coordinates, phone, email, website, open now and business hours for every day, retailer services, minimum age, menu size and verified items, online-ordering details, accepted payments, curbside pickup, best-of-Weedmaps and social-equity flags, top deals, intro text and `raw` (the listing as the site returns it: description, amenities, licenses, social links, pictures...). Without `type`, dispensaries are tried first, then deliveries and doctors.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/weedmaps-listing

parameters.description: The listing slug from its link (weedmaps.com/dispensaries/<slug>) or listing results.

get.description:
A dispensary's or delivery service's menu with every filter of its menu page: keyword, category (e.g. flower, vape-pens, edibles, disposable), brand, effect/flavour tag, deal, verified products only, price range and 10 sorts. Each item: id, name, slug, category, brand, verified flag, price and every price option (weight or unit, sale and original price), THC and CBD, strain, online orderable, current deal, rating, image and `raw`. `facets=true` adds the menu's categories, brands, tag groups (with tag uuids for `tag`), price ranges and deals with counts. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/weedmaps-listing-menu

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A weedmaps.com listing link, instead of slug.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma list of category slugs (see `facets`), e.g. flower or disposable.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Comma list of brand slugs, e.g. stiiizy.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Comma list of tag uuids from `facets.tag_groups` (effects, flavours...).

parameters.name: deal
parameters.description: A deal slug from `facets.deals`, or any for every item on sale.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: true: add the menu's filter options with counts.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Weedmaps dispensaries, deliveries and doctors near a place
get.description:
Dispensaries, delivery services, doctors, CBD/hemp stores and venues near a place, as the Weedmaps map lists them: type, retailer services, amenities (payments, ATM, accessibility, recreational/medical, online ordering, live menu, social equity...), stores carrying a brand, stores with a promo code, radius and 9 sorts. Each listing: id, name, slug, type, link, rating and review count, license type, address, coordinates, distance, phone, email, website, open now, closes in, today's hours, retailer services, minimum age, menu size, online-ordering details (pickup, delivery, ETA, minimum, fee), accepted payments, curbside pickup, top deals, intro text and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/weedmaps-listings

parameters.name: services
parameters.description: Comma list: storefront, delivery, mail_order, doctor, cbd_only, pickup, venue, hemp_only.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Comma list, e.g. accepts_credit_cards,has_atm,is_recreational. All: accepts_cashless_payments, accepts_credit_cards, accepts_debit_cards, accepts_ach, best_of_weedmaps, has_videos, has_handicap_access, has_atm, has_curbside_pickup, has_security_guard, is_recreational, is_medical, verified_seller, has_endorsement_badges, has_delivery_ordering_online, has_pickup_ordering_online, has_ordering_online, eighteen_plus, twenty_one_plus, social_equity, has_live_menu.

get.summary: Weedmaps reviews of a dispensary, delivery, doctor, product or strain
get.description:
Published reviews of a dispensary, delivery service, doctor, brand product or strain: title, text, rating and sub-ratings, date, verified flag, helpful count, the reviewer's public Weedmaps username, review count and avatar (when set), and the business's reply. Also the average rating, the rating distribution and dimensions. Six sorts and a rating range. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/weedmaps-reviews

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
